className.description: A string of all className you want applied to the base component.
className.name: className

closeButton.description: Add a close button component to the header.
closeButton.name: closeButton

closeLabel.description:
Overrides the close button's accessible name (defaults to `'Close'`). Set this for
non-English UIs.
closeLabel.name: closeLabel

component.description: Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component.
component.name: component

asChild.description:
Render the single child element in place of this component's own element, with this
component's classes, props and ref merged onto it: `<Button asChild><Link href="/login">Log
in</Link></Button>`. The alternative to `component` for React Server Components — an element
can be passed from the server to this package's client components, a component reference
(`component={Link}`) can't.
asChild.name: asChild
